title: M365 Baseline Toolkit - Desired State Configuration
description: Data-only desired-state definition for the M365 Baseline Toolkit. This file must never contain executable PowerShell - only typed values describing what each control's desired state should be. Control logic lives in the PowerShell modules under /modules.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this config schema. Must match a version this toolkit understands.

baselineSource.description: Human-readable citation for where this baseline came from (e.g. a CIS benchmark version).

controls.description: One entry per control. Every id here must have a matching Get-<id>State/Set-<id>State function pair in the control catalog, and every catalog function pair must be referenced here - the orchestrator treats a mismatch in either direction as a validation error.

id.description: Stable control identifier. Must match the suffix used by the control catalog's Get-<id>State/Set-<id>State function names.

workload.description: Which M365 workload this control belongs to / which connection it primarily requires.

enabled.description: Whether this control is evaluated/applied on this run. Disabled controls are skipped entirely and excluded from reports.

automatable.description: false = audit-only; no supported Set- action exists. Such controls are always reported, never silently applied, and Apply/Restore mark them Skipped-Manual.

desiredValue.description: Typed desired value for this control. Shape is control-specific (string, bool, number, array, or object) and is defined by the control's Get-/Set- function contract, never by executable syntax.

description.description: Short human-readable explanation of what the control does, shown in reports.

complianceMode.description: How to compare current vs. desired value. Equality (default) does a deep structural comparison. Range treats desiredValue as {min,max} and current Value as a number.

manualInstructions.description: Required when automatable is false. Points the admin at the exact GUI location to change this setting by hand.

requiresPopulatedFields.description: Names of top-level properties inside desiredValue that must be non-empty (non-empty array/string) before Apply is allowed to run for this control, because no safe universal default exists (e.g. tenant-specific domain lists).

tier.description: Required for workload: ConditionalAccess. 1 = requires Entra ID P1 (or P2). 2 = requires Entra ID P2 specifically. Ignored for every other workload.

forceCreateDespiteOverlap.description: ConditionalAccess controls only. When a non-toolkit-owned CA policy heuristically looks like it already covers this control, creation is skipped by default (Skipped-PotentialOverlap) - set true, after reviewing the conflicting policy, to create this toolkit-owned report-only policy alongside it anyway. Defaults to false. Ignored for every other workload.

mechanismPossiblyDeprecated.description: Set true for a control whose underlying Set- mechanism is known to be silently retired/migrated by Microsoft on an unannounced per-tenant schedule (e.g. SharePointOnline-AzureADB2BIntegration's Entra B2B auto-migration). When set, a persistent post-apply read-back mismatch is reported as MechanismPossiblyDeprecated instead of the ordinary Applied-PendingConfirmation status, so it isn't mistaken for a toolkit bug. Defaults to false.
